mechanism.uniformIdentity: SHA-256(algorithm|outer-cursor|lane), first 52 bits plus one half ulp
mechanism.cardKey: log(uniform) / finite non-negative effective weight; highest unselected key wins
mechanism.identityPath: absent, empty or effective authored weight-one configuration calls the unchanged legacy reward function
mechanism.poolRule: sample without replacement from the eligible reveal-gated effective rarity pool
mechanism.failureRule: invalid, non-finite, negative, all-zero, duplicate-base or under-supported explicit pools return no card reward
mechanism.outerCursorRule: counter-based exposure draws never advance RunState; the existing stale-cursor contract remains unchanged

separatedRoutes.resonantLanceNote: The exact #520 reveal-all diagnostic had four authored duplicate entries; the reveal adder did not add a fifth because the ID was already present.

cohort.policies: The frozen #520 v3 cohort: sixteen issue-519 registered functional policies plus RandomBuild and RandomPlay controls.
cohort.reveals: BalanceSim mature-three-act-no-side-state-v1 with every authored reveal ID open

firstGate.identityReplay: The identity-config whole-run outputDigest must equal the reused live baseline for every policy, grid and seed.
firstGate.selectiveRandomRegression: Versus live baseline, RandomBuild win rate falls by at least 0.15 while the sixteen-policy global mean falls by no more than 0.10.
firstGate.globalDifficultyComparator: Versus live baseline, the exact global-difficulty intervention lowers the sixteen-policy global mean by at least 0.10 and does not satisfy selectiveRandomRegression.
firstGate.routeSeparation: Both native route interventions improve the sixteen-policy global mean, and multi-route minus single-route mean viable-policy count is at least 1.0.
firstGate.viability: Per grid, a policy is viable at observed win rate at least max(0.25, RandomBuild plus 0.15); report the four-grid mean.
firstGate.reliability: Every native intervention has zero additional non-win/loss outcomes or non-empty errors relative to identity control.
firstGate.aspectIdentity: Duskblade records no Smolder kills and Ashwarden records no shatters; identity replay must remain exact.
firstGate.vow5: Identity replay is exact in both Vow-5 grids. Diagnostic causal interventions are not promotion candidates and their Vow-5 rates are recorded, not silently admitted.
firstGate.determinism: The focused sampler mutation check passes and an identical complete simulation identity is served only from the content-addressed cache.

conditionalFullSuite.stableExposureReplication: The 20200-20215 full-suite panel is held separate from the 20300-20315 first gate.

stop: If any first-gate requirement fails, emit one bounded negative, spend zero full-suite or QD/BO rows, and create no successor.
